title: Hoist duplicated seder-Hebrew-name and Torah-title static tables from sibling *_fetcher.dart classes into SefariaFetcherBase
why: bavli_fetcher.dart and mishna_fetcher.dart each carry their own byte-identical 6-entry seder-name Hebrew map; chumash_fetcher.dart and nach_fetcher.dart each carry their own identical 5-book Torah-title list. All four subclasses extend SefariaFetcherBase, which is the natural single home for this static reference data, but it exposes neither — so a spelling fix or a new entry has to be applied in two files with nothing enforcing they stay in sync.
recommendation: Add a shared `torahTitles` list and a `sederHebrewName(String)` lookup to SefariaFetcherBase (or a small shared sefaria_reference_data.dart) and have the four fetchers reference it instead of their private copies.
acceptance_criteria: Only one definition each of the seder-name map and the Torah-title list exists under tool/lib/sefaria/
bavli/mishna/chumash/nach fetcher output is unchanged after switching to the shared constant
